audit.description: The changed production file api/tokens.py imports the real httpx package and replaces the migrated outbound calls with httpx.post(...) and httpx.get(...). The diff removes the requests dependency from pyproject.toml and pinned requirements while adding httpx and its dependencies. Although api/tokens.py keeps a requests = httpx compatibility alias, the evidence shows no direct or dynamic import of the real requests source library, and dynamic tracing resolves httpx to site-packages with target_local_spec_count 0.
evidence: api/tokens.py: import requests replaced by import httpx, with calls changed to httpx.post(...) and httpx.get(...)
api/tokens.py: requests = httpx is an alias to the target package, not an import or use of the source requests package
pyproject.toml and requirements*.txt remove requests and add httpx/httpcore dependencies
dynamic metrics: target_events_from_production_repo_count=25, first target import from api/tokens.py, origin site-packages/httpx/__init__.py, target_local_spec_count=0
reasons: Production code meaningfully calls httpx.post and httpx.get
No changed production code imports or dynamically loads requests
Target import resolves to installed httpx package, not a local fake provider
Dependency files replace requests with httpx
